description.value: La Quercia is a refined northern Italian restaurant on Vancouver's West 4th Avenue, anchored by a seasonally focused menu built on slow-cooking traditions with housemade bread, charcuterie, preserves, and butchery. Chef Adam Pegg offers both à la carte dining and convivial family-style tasting menus, supported by an in-house sommelier and an extensive all-Italian wine list. An attached Deli counter sells prepared meals, sandwiches, and piadine to take away, offering touring cyclists a quality grab-and-go option on a well-travelled cycling corridor.
